caption:
In Katanzama, a remote Arhuaco community in Colombia, repurposed EV batteries are accelerated last-mile energy access. BATx, a youth led startup, has deployed 40 kWh of second-life battery storage to power a school, health outpost, and cultural center, supporting education, healthcare and community resilience. 🔆 

With the support of #Youth4Climate (UNDP Rome Centre) and other strategic partnerships with local organizations, this project is showing the power of collaboration, community involvement, and circular economy in action. ⚡ 
 
Renewable energy action goes beyond infrastructure.  it’s about creating opportunities and making sure no one gets left behind in the energy transition.
